key_points: It solves a problem by solving smaller versions of the same problem

rounds.kid_question: How is that different from a loop?
key_points: Each call works on a smaller input
A base case stops the calls
Results are combined as the calls return
Some problems are naturally made of smaller copies of themselves
It can make code shorter and clearer than a loop

rounds.kid_question: Can you give me an example?
key_points: A concrete case such as factorial or walking a folder tree
The example names its base case
